accounts.name: market_state
docs: Anchor's `Account<MarketState>` would try to borsh-deserialize the existing
460-byte buffer against the new 476-byte layout BEFORE realloc and fail
with `AccountDidNotDeserialize (3003)`. We sidestep that by taking the
account as `UncheckedAccount` and doing realloc + write manually.

(2B @509, written 0; the per-market margin migration then sets it to 50).

instructions.name: migrate_market_state_v4

partial_liq_target_health (default 0 = partial disabled) at offset 511. LEN 511→515.

instructions.name: set_trading_halt
docs: Admin emergency venue-wide trading halt. `mode`: 0 = None (normal /
resume), 1 = ReduceOnly (block opens/increases/new orders/margin/
funding; closes, cancels and liquidations stay open — the venue-wide
equivalent of per-market `is_paused`), 2 = Full (additionally freeze
closes + liquidations). One reversible tx halts (1/2) or resumes (0).
The on-chain `ProtocolConfig.halt_mode` is the single source of truth.

`buildUpdateFundingRateIx`. Auto-resolved by the Anchor client.

types.name: HaltModeChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_trading_halt` on every venue-wide halt-mode change (halt
AND resume). External monitors (e.g. a Telegram alert bot) can subscribe to
observe the transition; the indexer itself reads `halt_mode` on-demand via
`getAccountInfo` rather than consuming this event.

fields.name: mode
docs: New halt mode: 0 = None (normal), 1 = ReduceOnly, 2 = Full.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin signer that made the change.

fields.name: ts
docs: Unix timestamp (slot clock) of the change.

types.name: OpenPositionArgs
docs: BREAKING (v4): `collateral_usdc` has been replaced by an explicit
`wallet_collateral + from_queue_amount` split per spec §5.4.
`position_nonce` replaces the old `nonce` field name.
`min_output_usdc` is added for future SL/TP integration (currently unused at open).

fields.name: funding_charge
docs: Signed funding settled at close, 6-dec USDC. `> 0` = trader paid funding,
`< 0` = trader received it; subtracted from `net_return` on-chain. Appended
last so the field is byte-additive (old decoders read the prefix unchanged).

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Per-program protocol authority. One PDA per program at seeds = [b"protocol_config"].
Holds the admin pubkey gating privileged init instructions (initialize_market).
Single-key, no two-step handover (intentional pre-mainnet posture; rotation deferred to v1.1).

fields.name: halt_mode
docs: Venue-wide emergency trading halt (see `HaltMode`). 0 = None, 1 =
ReduceOnly, 2 = Full. Set/reset in one reversible `set_trading_halt`
tx. Carved from the first byte of the old `_reserved`, so existing
on-chain PDAs decode it as 0 (= None, normal operation) the moment the
program is redeployed — no realloc, no migration FOR THIS CHANGE: the
struct is already `LEN` (126) on-chain (the 72→126 Phase-1 growth +
`migrate_protocol_config_v2` is long done), and this carve only
repartitions the existing 31-byte `_reserved` region (→ 1 + 30), so
`LEN` is unchanged. Mirrors the `InsuranceFund.auto_payouts_frozen` precedent.

types.name: ReferralRebateAccrued
docs: Emitted by `close_position` whenever `credit_affiliate_cut` credits the
`AffiliateReward` PDA with a non-zero `affiliate_cut`. Carries enough fields
to power the indexer's `/referral-stats?code=<affiliate_pubkey>` aggregate
without joining against `PositionClosed` rows — `size_usdc` is the close
notional (for `volumeReferred`), `amount` is the rebate (for
`rebatesEarned`), and the trade-count aggregate is just `COUNT(*)` filtered
by `affiliate`. Closes followup #99 (path A — emit canonical event from the
rebate-credit site instead of polling AffiliateReward PDAs or approximating
from referral-attribution PDAs).

fields.name: affiliate
docs: Affiliate wallet that earned the rebate (matches `AffiliateReward.affiliate`).

fields.name: owner
docs: Trader whose close generated the rebate.

fields.name: size_usdc
docs: Close notional (USDC scale 1e6) — sums into `volumeReferred`.

fields.name: amount
docs: Rebate amount credited to the affiliate (USDC scale 1e6) —
sums into `rebatesEarned`.
